===Rolling Thunder=== 
*<sm2>Rolling Thunder cast.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Pangolier during the cast time (80% vol).
*<sm2>Rolling Thunder loop.mp3</sm2> Loop sound plays on Pangolier while rolling (70% vol).
*<sm2>Rolling Thunder layer.mp3</sm2> Loop layer sound together with the loop sound.
*<sm2>Rolling Thunder bounce.mp3</sm2> Bounce sound plays on Pangolier upon hitting a cliff.
*Bounce layer sounds play together with the bounce sound. These are responses used as ability sounds.
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 13.mp3</sm2> Uhn!
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 14.mp3</sm2> Oah!
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 15.mp3</sm2> Ah!
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 16.mp3</sm2> Ohh!
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 17.mp3</sm2> Wah.
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 18.mp3</sm2> Whoops.
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 19.mp3</sm2> Oi.
**<sm2>pangolin ability4 20.mp3</sm2> Uhhuh.
*<sm2>Rolling Thunder enemy.mp3</sm2> Stun sound plays on colliding enemies upon colliding with them (50% pitch if it is a creep).
*<sm2>Rolling Thunder end.mp3</sm2> End sound plays on Pangolier whenever the rolling stops in any way.
